title.fr: Diviseurs de tension et de courant

formula: Diviseur de tension: U₂ = E · R₂/(R₁+R₂) ;  Diviseur de courant: I₁ = I · R₂/(R₁+R₂)
sketch:
Observe: schematic canvas with two configurations: (a) voltage
divider — E driving R₁ in series with R₂, voltmeter across R₂
shows U₂ = E·R₂/(R₁+R₂); (b) current divider — I feeding R₁ ∥ R₂,
ammeters in each branch show I₁ = I·R₂/(R₁+R₂). Sliders: R₁, R₂,
E (or I). Formula HUD updates live. Experiment: reach a target U₂
or I₁ by choosing R₁, R₂. Evaluate: one resistor slider hidden;
student solves for it from a target reading. Wrinkle: pedagogical
symmetry — the two configurations are dual (voltage ↔ current,
series ↔ parallel).
